storyBlocks.sourceHtml: We were so ready to get back to the cabin and start moving things forward that I forgot to take photos of some of the biggest upgrades. storyBlocks.sourceHtml: Getting back up there for the first time that year felt awesome.

storyBlocks.sourceHtml: After the long Michigan winter, the cabin almost felt new again. The air still had that cool spring edge to it, and we were burning fallen tree branches from winter in the fire pit, just enjoying being back. It was one of those simple spring moments that probably would not look dramatic to anyone else, but to us it felt like the season was finally opening back up.
